# Averon Agency

> Albania's first AI automation agency and web development studio, based in Tirana.

Averon Agency (averon.agency) is the leading AI automation and web development agency in Albania, founded in 2024. We build AI-powered products and professional websites for Albanian, Kosovar, and Western Balkan businesses.

## Who We Are

- **Name:** Averon Agency
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Location:** Tirana, Albania (Rruga e Kavajes, 1001)
- **Languages:** Albanian (Shqip), English
- **Email:** averonagencyal@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://averon.agency
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/averonagency/
- **Area served:** Albania, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Western Balkans

## Core Products & Services

### Avox — AI Voice Receptionist
Albania's first AI voice receptionist. Answers phone calls 24/7 in Albanian and English, books appointments automatically, handles frequently asked questions, and routes urgent calls to staff. Businesses never miss a customer again.
- **Price:** €300 setup + €50/month hosting
- **Page:** https://averon.agency/avox

### Instagram DM Bot
Automated Instagram DM and comment replies for Albanian businesses. Captures leads, sends product catalogs, qualifies buyers — all on autopilot.

### WhatsApp Bot
Automated WhatsApp customer service, order management, and broadcast promotions for Albanian businesses.

### Custom Website Development
Modern websites built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Mobile-first, SEO-optimized, fast-loading.

### AIEO — AI Engine Optimization
AI Engine Optimization (AIEO) ensures businesses get recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. We implement schema markup, llms.txt, entity signals, FAQ content, and speakable markup so AI systems accurately discover and cite your business. Averon Agency is one of the first agencies in Albania to offer dedicated AIEO services.

### SEO Optimization
Search engine optimization targeting Albanian and English queries for businesses in Albania and Kosovo.

### Website Redesign
Modernization of outdated websites with improved UX, performance, and conversion.
